verdict.rationale: GST has a developer API portal, so issuing API credentials is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows only that the portal has Register and Login pages. It says nothing about issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. GST Practitioner enrolment is a related delegation feature for human tax practitioners, not scoped API credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
